text: ぼくは　たたかうの　むいて　ないな　かえって　イラスト　でも　かいてよう

structure.jp: たたかうの　むいて　ないな
structure.en: I'm not suited to battling, huh

structure.jp: イラスト　でも　かいてよう
structure.en: I'll be drawing illustrations or something

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. Here the に that would follow it is dropped in casual speech. たたかうの = 'battling'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb tells of a lasting state, and here it is the negative, shortened in casual speech from むいていない. むいて　ない = 'am not suited to it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing gives it as a loose example, one choice among others. イラスト　でも = 'illustrations or something'.
